text:
I LEAVE IT TO YOU.
I can decide?
Me?
A promise is a promise.
Besides...
I've seen that
your convictions
are more than empty words.
That's what you mean,
right, Falzen?
YES...
Then...?
I LOOK FORWARD TO
OUR CONTINUED FRIENDSHIP...
Do whatever you want.
I can decide?
Me?
It is only right to entrust
human judgment to human hands.
And...
I've witnessed
your resolve
for myself.
You agree, do you not,
Yafha?
Hmph. I just
don't want the bother.
Then...?
Sheesh, do I really
have to spell it out?
It means I accept you.
Well, here's
what I think...
Then how does
this sound?
Come along, Mr. Beard!
You can't spend all day
slacking off!
That's right. Come on,
get to work!
Wh-Why do I
have to work
in the fields!?
Those who don't work
don't eat, as they say.
You've got to grow back
the vegetables you ate
and pay them back.
You got off lightly.
You'd better be grateful
that teacher's so kindhearted.
That's the truth,
brother.
Grrrr...!
That's why...!
I hate
going ashore!
This incident marked
the beginning
of our friendship
with the islanders.
Part of me almost wants
to thank Jakini
for that...
Working in the fields must be hard,
but at least they're
getting proper meals.
I hope they won't
hold a grudge against us.
What worries me is
▲.
Lately, there's been less conversation.
We hardly talk
except when it's necessary.
What could be causing it?
I'm a little worried...
Whatever brought it about,
we have begun
to get to know
the people of this island.
